name: neuregulin 1

function.text: NRG1 encodes pro-neuregulin-1, membrane-bound isoform [Cleaved into: Neuregulin-1]. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and chemorepellent activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
